name: Cypress Pipeline

values.EndLocation: Florida Gas Transmission interconnection, Clay County

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The Southern Natural Gas system row P0252 and the South System Expansion 4 row P7855 do not cover it. Elba Express P3295 is a different line, from Elba Island north to South Carolina. A May 2005 to July 2005 Federal Register notice of the FERC application in docket CP05-388 describes the Cypress Pipeline Project in Georgia and Florida: 176.43 miles of 24-inch and 30-inch pipe, three phases with in-service dates of May 2007, May 2009 and May 2010, and 500,000 Mcf per day of firm capacity. The 2001 notice (166 miles, 24-inch, 310,000 Mcf per day) is the earlier version of the project and is not used for values. The EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), row 446 (SONAT Cypress 2007 Phase 1, Completed, 167 miles, 335 MMcf/d, 24 inch, cost 240 million dollars, in service May 2007, states GA and FL) and row 499 (Phase 2, Completed April 2008, 21 miles, 100 MMcf/d, Georgia). So status is operating for at least phases 1 and 2. Whether the 2010 phase was built was not confirmed. Length and capacity are the certificated full-project figures, staged in original units; phase 1 alone was 167 miles and 335 MMcf/d. The Clay County, Florida end point is from the notice context and the earlier candidate note, not confirmed by a second document; the FGT interconnection is presumed. The notice states no owner share. Owner uses the existing gazetteer spelling Southern Natural Gas. Cost not staged because EIA gives only phase 1. EIA and the FERC notice are both government releases, so independence is partial. Route not researched; no route staged. Length is well above the 25 km threshold, sponsor and FERC certificate application are concrete steps. Row shape follows the expansion rule: PipelineName is the parent system name, SegmentName is the project.
